properties.notes: Seghill Social Club site, comprising a large two-storey building and small car parking area. Now vacant following closure and available for redevelopment. Provides an opportunity for a small infill scheme. Demolition of the redundant club required. An application for redevelopment of the site for 8 homes following clearance is now in place (17/03368/FUL). Development has yet to commence but is forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
